items.a: An intelligence engine configured for your topic: a profile, sectors, thematic axes and a list of sources. Every day it reads what is published, scores it by relevance and delivers only what matters.

items.q: Where does the information come from?
items.a: From public sources: sector media, official bodies, universities, think tanks and reference organisations. Each piece links to its original source.

items.q: What role does artificial intelligence play?
items.a: It classifies, scores and summarises the information, and drafts each report. Before publishing, a person reviews and approves it. All AI-generated content is identified as such.

You tell us what you want to watch and we prepare your profile before the first meeting. At that meeting we fine-tune it with you. Daily reading starts on the activation day and the first radar arrives within days.

items.q: What if the result does not match what we agreed?
items.a: If during the first 30 days the first harvest does not meet what we agreed in writing, we refund your first month. Your configuration is yours and you can take it with you.

Each plan includes a monthly pool of credits. Each active watcher uses a fixed share, and the rest is split between reports, versions in other languages and the assistant. If you run short, you can buy more. Daily reading of your sources never stops because of a lack of credits.

items.q: In which languages are the reports?
items.a: Sources are read in Spanish and English. The report is written in Spanish or English, and can have reviewed versions in French, German, Portuguese and Italian.

items.q: Can I change what I watch?
items.a: Yes. Your administrators adjust sources, keywords, axes and sectors whenever they need to, within their plan.

items.q: Who in my team can log in?
items.a: Administrators configure and manage. Readers have one of four levels: query, reports, analyst or curator.

items.q: Can I share the reports outside my organisation?
items.a: Yes. You can publish them on your website or give access to external readers, and decide whether to charge them.

items.q: Can a public administration contract Voralis?
items.a: Yes. We offer an annual contract adapted to the procurement procedure of each body, with electronic invoicing and human review of each report before publishing.
Yes. Monthly plans have no commitment. If you cancel, we keep your watchers frozen for 90 days in case you come back, and your configuration can be exported.

items.q: Are the reports in the catalog from Voralis?
items.a: No. Each report is published by the organisation that produced it, on its own website, and is responsible for its content.
